blocks.text: Network Interface Card (NIC) kisi device ko network se connect (jorne) deta hai (jaise Figure 1.6 mein). Yeh wired (taar wala) bhi ho sakta hai aur wireless bhi. Har NIC ka ek unique (sirf usi ka) address hota hai jise MAC address kehte hain. NIC network se data bhejta aur receive (wusool) karta hai. NIC ke baghair device network par communicate (baat) nahi kar sakta. Zyada tar modern (naye) devices mein NIC pehle se built-in (andar laga) hota hai.

blocks.alt: Network interface card: chips aur sunehri connector wala sabz circuit board, jo dhaat ki patti (bracket) se laga hai; bracket par lage socket ka label Ethernet Port hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.6: Network Interface Card (NIC) (kitab ki Figure 1.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.explanation: NIC ka unique address jo device ke network hardware ki pehchan karata hai; har NIC ka alag hota hai.

items: NIC: device ko network se jorta hai; wired ya wireless; har NIC ka MAC address; is ke baghair baat-cheet nahi.
